data.segment_title: Introduction Brian Williams (Vero Beach, Florida), John Seigenthaler (New York)

data.segment_description:
(Studio: John Seigenthaler)  Weather map shown of Hurricane Frances churning over Florida. 
 (Vero Beach: Robert Hager)  The impact of the hurricane on the Vero Beach area featured; scenes shown of a blown-off roof, last night's wind & rain, power lines doing down, fires, bent trees, flooded streets & a sinkhole on I-95.  [Resident Tony COTTRELL, Mayor Thomas WHITE, resident James TRUSTIE&nbsp- comment on the storm's severity.] 
 (Vero Beach: Brian Williams)  Report introduced. 
 (West Palm Beach: Mark Potter)  The impact of the storm on West Palm Beach reviewed; scenes shown of flooded streets, last night's wind, rain, downed power lines & debris.  [Police Lt. Mike ROGEN‡- comments on the curfew, the residents' frustration & looting.] 
 (Vero Beach: Brian Williams)  Report introduced. 
 (Orlando: Don Teague)  The story of kids from inner city Boston on a dream tour of Orlando, Florida, theme parks presented; scenes shown of wind & rain & the stranded children in a hotel.  [In Boston, father Graham HAWKINS&nbsp- worries.]  [Kid Christopher TOLER; in Boston, his MOTHER&nbsp- comment on the hurricane.] 
 (Vero Beach: Brian Williams)  Report introduced. 
 (West Palm Beach: Al Roker)  The course of Hurricane Frances updated; weather maps shown.
